verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI documents programmatic access to the messages exchanged during agent runs, and a community user confirms conversations can be serialized and deserialized as JSON. Its model-agnostic design also reduces provider lock-in, which makes leaving easier. However, the evidence does not describe a complete data export in open formats; missing for 10: first-party documentation of an open export format for all data, export of data held in the associated hosted services (Logfire traces, AI Gateway), and an explicit migration or exit path.
